item.title: Fortinet report flags widening “complexity gap” in cloud security as teams struggle to keep pace
item.description: Cloud security is becoming harder to manage, not because organisations lack tools, but because the pace and scale of cloud adoption are outstripping security teams’ ability to maintain real-time visibility and control. That is the central finding of Fortinet’s 2026 State of Cloud Security Report, which points to what it calls a growing “complexity gap” across enterprise cloud environments.
